assetOrigin: Original procedural mesh, embedded PBR maps, skeleton and animation; no third-party inputs.

artDirection.silhouette: Retired domain grandmaster in a tailored wide-sleeved ink-blue crane robe with a defined waist, long folded skirt panels, ivory trousers and three intact concentric antique-gold domain rings.
artDirection.bodyDetail: Sculpted torso rings, layered collar and belt, draped sleeves with geometric fold ridges and slim tapered cuffs, articulated fingers and thumbs, shaped shoe uppers, layered soles and stitched seams.
artDirection.face: Silver-white hair in a high topknot with a gold pin, short forked beard, mustache and restrained facial marks.
artDirection.props: Jade pendant, jade ring token, robe trim and three gold rings with jade beads and index marks attached to DomainPivot.
artDirection.motion: Measured breathing, stable shuffle, deliberate palm strike, hand-seal cast with ring expansion, controlled recoil and grounded fall.
artDirection.distinction: No conical straw hat, no long generic white beard and no broken halo; the intact domain rings are the defining silhouette.
artDirection.gameplay: No passive, domain damage rule or skill behavior is implied. All eight clips are generic visual poses only.

rig.type: glTF SkinnedMesh skeleton with baked TRS animation tracks
rig.binding: Continuous three-bone limb skinning; rigid parts use one normalized joint weight. DomainPivot follows Chest.

clips.name: idle
clips.semantic: measured breathing, ring rotation and robe sway

clips.name: walk
clips.semantic: stable in-place shuffle with sleeve and skirt-panel follow-through

clips.name: swing
clips.semantic: deliberate palm strike and domain-ring turn

clips.name: cast
clips.semantic: hand seals with three-ring expansion and rotation

clips.name: flinch
clips.semantic: forced backward recoil and brief ring instability

clips.name: dead
clips.semantic: grounded fall with right arm and skirt panel drawn inward to avoid penetration

clips.name: victory
clips.semantic: raised palm and controlled ring rotation

integration.runtimeRegistration: Not performed; production CharacterRig integration remains a separate task.

cuffRefinement.preservedSilhouette: Wide draped upper sleeves with a narrow antique-gold cuff at the wrist.

limitations: Polished procedural stylization, not a photorealistic scan or externally generated character.
The domain rings are visual presentation only; no gameplay field, damage or control effect is included.
Runtime registration and CharacterRig integration are intentionally excluded.
